simple.summary: אֲזִקִּים (ʼăziqqîym) means manacles First listed occurrence: Jer 40 1.

definitions.full: H246. azeq [ אֲזֵק ] noun [masculine] id., specifically manacle , only plural manacles בָּאזִקִּים אָסוּר Jer 40:1 , and עליֿדך אֲשֶׁר מִןהָֿאזִקִּים 40:4 . זָר see I. זָרָא זור, see below II. זור . זֵר see III. זוּר .
